reason: Integrates OpenAI/ChatGPT subscription accounts into DeepSeek Harness, enabling access to supported models for chat and image-related interactions through account authorization.

summaries.zh: 将 OpenAI/ChatGPT 订阅账户接入 DeepSeek Harness，以使用订阅支持的模型进行聊天、图像理解、图像生成和图像编辑。
summaries.en: Connects OpenAI/ChatGPT subscription accounts to DeepSeek Harness for supported model access, including chat, image understanding, image generation, and image editing.

capabilities: Authenticates and stores third-party OpenAI subscription credentials
Connects DeepSeek Harness to models covered by an OpenAI subscription
Supports text chat, image understanding, image generation, and image editing
